message.content:
The campaign was not successful. Although the overall average revenue per completed order was higher in the email channel (44.72 USD) than in the paid_search channel (23.47 USD), this difference is due to confounding by customer segment. The email campaign was deliberately targeted at loyal customers, who have higher average revenue regardless of the channel.

When comparing within each customer segment, the email channel underperformed in every group:
- Loyal customers: email (82.44 USD) vs paid_search (108.09 USD), difference = -25.65 USD
- New customers: email (4.20 USD) vs paid_search (10.59 USD), difference = -6.38 USD
- Returning customers: email (26.80 USD) vs paid_search (34.70 USD), difference = -7.90 USD

The raw comparison is invalid because the groups are not comparable — the email channel had 131 loyal customers vs 26 in paid_search, and 64 new customers vs 304 in paid_search. A valid assessment requires stratification by segment, which shows the campaign did not succeed.

The evidence is based entirely on values printed by code.
